modalities.evidence: Landmark points for each CT/CBCT image pair

output.population: 58 pelvic cases, each with a CT/CBCT image pair and an average of 154 (range: 91-212) selected landmark pairs.
output.summary: Expert-selected landmark points on paired pelvic CT and cone-beam CT images, providing a statistically characterized reference dataset for validating rigid image registration against an estimated ground truth.
